$note: Version-bearing files, enumerated once. Only files that must BECOME the new version belong here — never a historical marker. ROADMAP.md and docs/specs/ mention v0.3.1 as a record of what happened and must not be bumped; CHANGELOG's shipped headings likewise.

files.$note: The one the build and the release workflow's verify job read. The tag's v prefix is stripped and compared against this.
The line a reader sees before they download anything.

todos: MECHANICAL: close CHANGELOG.md's [Unreleased] into '## [{NEW}] - {TODAY}' and open a fresh empty [Unreleased] above it. Use mcp__ants__changelog_log op:release with version {NEW}; it refuses nothing_to_release on an empty section and version_exists on a duplicate heading, both of which are the checks you want.
post_check: v=$(sed -n 's/^project(gameshub VERSION \([0-9.]*\).*/\1/p' CMakeLists.txt); r=$(sed -n 's/^Current version \([0-9.]*\).*/\1/p' README.md); grep -q "^## \[$v\] - " CHANGELOG.md || { echo "CHANGELOG has no dated section for $v"; exit 1; }; [ "$v" = "$r" ] || { echo "drift: CMakeLists $v vs README $r"; exit 1; }; echo "version $v consistent across CMakeLists.txt, README.md and CHANGELOG.md"
